raw.rationale: This launched adenosine receptor antagonist (likely theophylline/aminophylline-like) is not a cytotoxic anticancer agent and at 2.5 µM for 5 days would not be expected to produce lineage-selective killing; PRISM single-concentration screens of non-oncology drugs rarely show selective lineage effects, and no published lineage-selective cytotoxicity supports any lineage. Thus probabilities are near the low end of the stated base rate for all lineages.
